items.label: Small Computer And Vanity Desk
items.value: Dimension is 31.5'' L x 15.7'' W x 31''H , short desk, space saving, great for student teens kids writing desk for bedroom. It is also a very good choice as a dressing vanity table with drawers. The desk is USPTO Patent Approved.

items.label: Modern Simple Style Design
items.value: Computer desk with 2-tier fabric open drawers with wooden front for storage, providing plenty of room for under-desk storage and organization. This splice board desk is made of thick P2 particle wood board with scratch-resistant, anti-collision and waterproof, protect home office desk surface from daily wear and tear.

items.label: Sturdy Structure
items.value: Extra fixed steel brackets and adjustable leg pads provide greater stability, ensure the desktop is level, non-slip & anti-scratch protectors under the legs to protect your floor from scratching and reducing noises when moving.

items.label: Easy Assemble
items.value: A detailed instruction manual and tool are provided, no other tools required, quick and easy to assemble, about 20 - 30 minutes.

items.label: After-sale Service
items.value: Provides professional customer service, easy and fast replacement is guaranteed if have quality problem of the desk, please feel free to contact us.
